JPN.gmv_source_quote: In 2024, the value of the business-to-consumer (B2C) e-commerce market in Japan amounted to around 26.1 trillion Japanese yen. The market size grew steadily in the last decade.

IND.gmv_source_quote: Owing to the increasing internet user base and favorable market conditions, India has a lot of potential in the e-commerce industry. Growing at an exponential rate, the market value of the e-commerce industry in India was 125 billion U.S dollars in 2024.
IND._note: 两个估算：IBEF $125B (含数字+服务) vs Redseer $60B (仅商品 GMV)。前者作为 ecommerce_market 字段，后者标记为 narrow GMV 备注。

USA.gmv_source_quote: The revenue in the e-commerce market in the United States was modeled to amount to 1.18 trillion U.S. dollars in 2024. Following a continuous upward trend, the revenue has risen by 754.29 billion U.S. dollars since 2017. Between 2024 and 2029, the revenue will rise by 655.91 billion U.S. dollars, continuing its consistent upward trajectory.

categories_cagr_2017_2028._quote: The highest CAGR for the period of 2017 and 2028 was estimated to be in the food segment, amounting to almost 25 percent growth. Beauty, health, personal & household care is estimated to have over 14 percent CAGR.
